authority: Human explicitly delegated reasonable numeric criteria selection on 2026-10-24; existing authorization covers necessary measurement and publication. This is a new project implementation rule, not a quotation or external approval of the original guideline.
scope: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 MMLU-Pro fixed C200/H200, corrected KV-only independent reference and current corrected B1

quality.rule: Use existing C200 quality inputs/order, scorer, template, sampling and EOS contract. max8192 in both new quality arms. Actual implementation and resource identities must bind to the corresponding performance arm. No adjacent-source score transfer.
quality.interpretation: No decrease in this fixed subset point estimate; not a statistical non-inferiority proof or a full-corpus claim.
quality.reason: No task-quality degradation budget was supplied; do not introduce one merely to admit an optimization.

service.rule: Retain observed latency distributions; unavailable token-level timings stay unavailable. Deadlines are execution safety limits, not latency acceptance SLOs.

repeatability.reason: A 5% full-range limit bounds repeat instability of the reported empirical reference; it is a deterministic engineering screen, not a confidence interval.

applicability.workload_rule: Preserve C/H selection, category counts and input length bins. Compute C composition from pooled calibration ownF and actual token totals. Compare H composition to C; separately check B0/B1 composition against C before assigning a common reference. Use the same unambiguous necessary-work accounting categories, not implementation overhead or rejected draft work.
applicability.reason: 10% permits limited workload-induced variation beyond 5% repeat instability; separate work-composition gates prevent matching throughput alone from establishing applicability. None establishes equivalence outside this declared scope.
applicability.on_failure: Keep all own C results and failure evidence; no common-reference attainment claim.

execution.invalid_stop: First quality failure, runtime failure, source drift, missing ownF/T evidence, preemption, resource or cache contamination stops remaining windows. Slow valid results are retained; a stability/applicability failure is not a reason to replace a run. Any future retry requires a separately versioned plan and preserved failed evidence.

change_control: Freeze before new device results. Later scope changes require a prospective version and rationale; never change thresholds to obtain 90% or silently reevaluate prior outcomes.
